model_info.name: Phi-3-mini-4k-instruct_adjrs_lastprefill
model_info.note: adjust_rs x phase=prefill x last_token — exactly one steered token. All layers, because one token at one layer is too weak to flip a greedy argmax (a vacuous leg reads as a parity FAIL); breadth, not per-layer magnitude, since a large avg_proj diverges numerically.
